In this video, hosted by Marc 'Try4ce' Duddleson, we take an in-depth look at Final Fantasy 14, running on the Nintendo Switch 2. We analyse its 720p handheld and 1080p docked performance, 30fps target, and image quality settings. How does it stack up against other platforms? We compare Switch 2 directly to Xbox Series S, PS4, PS5, Series X, and PC handhelds like the Steam Deck, breaking down anti-aliasing, visual features, load times, and subscription model quirks.
